evidence: Original ANGLE archive plus eight actually acquired fixed dependencies; 48 target closure / 1629 source-input-script files / zero missing files.

Untouched upstream source archives are deliverable inputs; never ship the graph-review-only toolchain/host modifications as original source.

Historical MSVC/SDK build versions and binary byte reproducibility were not independently proven. Provide a real Windows build with recorded compiler/SDK versions before claiming a successful rebuild.

source_coverage.scope: macOS x64/arm64 compilation and modification source coverage for the pinned universal HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.1 dylib; historical byte-identical binary or generated-table reproduction is not claimed.
evidence: The Release preprocessor configuration expands to 428 supplied HarfBuzz source inputs plus the supplied Skia config-override.h; no non-system input is missing.
The macOS project compiles harfbuzz-subset.cc with HAVE_OT, HAVE_CONFIG_OVERRIDE_H, HB_NO_FALLBACK_SHAPE and NDEBUG. It does not compile hb-coretext.cc or link CoreText, FreeType or Graphite.
Unicode 15.1.0 UCD and grouped UCDXML fixed archives accompany the readable/modifiable generated tables and their scripts.
boundaries: The original C++ generated tables are modifiable source delivered directly in the fixed HarfBuzz archive. Exact historical Microsoft language-tags and IANA registry snapshots for a previously generated table have not been reconstructed; current online inputs are not represented as those snapshots.
The universal dylib links only platform libSystem and libc++; Apple compiler/SDK/platform libraries are external system dependencies, not copied third-party source inputs.

blocking_issues.reason: The shipped libSkiaSharp.dll contains Adobe DNG SDK code under separate software, document and technology patent terms. Compatibility with the combined AGPL/GPL distribution is unresolved; do not publish until resolved. Original notices and exact source were preserved, but attribution alone does not resolve compatibility.

The shipped Avalonia.Controls.dll contains compiled AutoCompleteBox, Calendar and CalendarDatePicker portions whose fixed upstream source explicitly declares the Microsoft Public License (Ms-PL); the AGPL application directly references this assembly. A specific alternative grant for those portions, an applicable AGPL linking exception or another reviewed authorization basis for this combination has not been established. Preserve the original notices, but keep public application distribution blocked until that authorization path is resolved.

observed_binary.evidence: Managed metadata contains the named types with actual IL method bodies; DictationAssistant.App.dll has a direct AssemblyRef to Avalonia.Controls 11.3.12.0.

The separately built HarfBuzzSharp package has its own exact native source mapping.
